definitions.short: properly, deferred , i.e. the morrow ; usually (adverbially) tomorrow ; indefinitely, hereafter
definitions.full: H4279. machar מָחָר 52 noun masculine , used often as adverb , tomorrow, in time to come (Aramaic מְחַר ; probably properly time in front , Kö ii. 263 , compare √, and Assyrian ma—ru , front , often of time, though always of former time, of old , Dl HWB 402 ); — 1 to-morrow (the day following the present day), a. as substantive Exod 16:23 לְי קֹדֶשׁ שַׁבַּת ׳שַׁבָּתוֺן מָחָר to-morrow is a sabbath, etc., 1Sam 20:5 מָחָר חֹדֶשׁ to-morrow is the new moon, 20:18 ; in מָחָר יוֺם Gen 30:33 ; Prov 27:1 ; Isa 56:12 ; in the idiomatic phrase מָחָר כָּעֵת at the like of the time, (being) to-morrow, = about to-morrow (see כְּ 1a ) Exod 9:18 ; 1Sam 9:16 ; 20:12 ; 1Kin 19:2 ; 20:6 ; 2Kin 7:1 , 18 ; 10:6 ; and in לְמָחָר Exod 8:19 הַזֶּה הָאֹת יִהְיֶה לְמָחָר , = for, against, to-morrow , 8:6 ; Num 11:18 ; Josh 7:13 ; Est 5:12 . b. as adverb accusative Exod 8:25 ; 9:5 ׳י הַזֶּה הַדָּבָר יַעֲשֶׂה מָחָר , 10:4 אַרְבֶּה מָחָר מֵבִיא הִנְנִי , 17:9 ; 32:5 ; Num 14:25 ; 1Sam 11:9 etc., Josh 11:6 הַזּאֹת כָּעֵת מָחָר ; opposed to הַיּוֺם Exod 19:10 וּמָחָר הַיּוֺם , Josh 22:18 ; 2Sam 11:12 a; rhetorically, Isa 22:13 נָמוּת מָחָר כִּי . 2 = in future time , Exod 13:14 לֵאמֹר מָחָר בִנְךָ יִשְׁאָֽלְךָ כִּי = Deut 6:20 ; Josh 4:6 , 21 ; 22:24 , 27 , 28 ; so מָחָר בְּיוֺם Gen 30:33 .
